Saltatorial_Catapult_Hindlegs.description: Massively hypertrophied hind legs storing terrifying levels of elastic potential energy within a localized pad of resilin. Upon release, the legs catapult the entity violently into the air with acceleration forces that would shatter vertebrate bones.

Cursorial_Multi_Jointed_Limbs.description: A set of long, spiky cursorial legs ending in microscopic tarsal claws (ungues) and adhesive pads (arolia). They facilitate mind-bending scuttling speeds across rough terrain and completely sheer surfaces without missing a beat.
